en.hero_title: Live, work and shop at one address.
en.hero_text: 268 acres in New Katameya where homes, the D5M mall, Mindhaus offices and Clubfive are a walk from each other. Seven minutes from Road 90.

pillars.title: Connected both ways
pillars.text: Two bridges built over the Ain Sokhna highway link District 5 back to New Cairo. Road 90 in seven minutes, the airport in nineteen.

pillars.title: Wadi Degla on the doorstep
pillars.text: The protectorate runs along the southern edge, so open desert is minutes away when you want it.

pillars.title: Everything walkable
pillars.text: Trails, bike lanes and landscaped parks connect the neighbourhoods to the mall, the offices and the club.

usps.title: D5M mall on site
usps.text: The first mall in New Katameya — fashion, cinemas, food court and a kids zone.

usps.title: Clubfive
usps.text: The sports and social club sits at the centre of the residential zone.

usps.title: Dstreet dining
usps.text: A dining strip developed with established restaurateurs rather than filled with whoever signs first.

usps.title: Work five minutes away
usps.text: Mindhaus is inside the development, so the commute can be a walk.

usps.title: 76,000 sqm site
usps.text: The Strip runs across 76,000 sqm of land with 45,000 sqm built-up area.

usps.title: Eight minutes to Road 90
usps.text: Connectivity to the business district without the traffic or the parking problem.

usps.title: Retail at the door
usps.text: D5M and Dstreet are walkable, so staff have lunch and shops on site.

usps.title: Flexible internally
usps.text: One, two or four separate vertical units, with common areas for each office.

panels.title: The Plateau
panels.text: The highest ground in the development, with underground parking and storage. Some units have roof terraces over the whole site.

panels.title: Clubside
panels.text: Overlooking Clubfive, with wide spacing between buildings so views stay open. Walking distance to D5M and Mindhaus.

panels.title: D Parks
panels.text: The last multi-family neighbourhood, three clusters each facing its own park — the Mind, the Body and the Soul — each with a different set of outdoor amenities.

panels.title: Villas & Homes
panels.text: Townhomes, court homes, twinvilles and single-family houses in modern earthy architecture, with generous interiors and mature landscaping.

panels.title: Mindhaus Strip
panels.text: For established medium-sized businesses wanting an independent building rather than a floor in someone else’s. Sellable offices in G+3 and G+4 formats, arranged as Privates, Twins and Quads — one, two or four vertical units, each with its own entrance.

panels.title: Mindhaus Campus
panels.text: 106,000 sqm of land with over 60,000 sqm of leasable office and retail across more than 110 modules, arranged around communal piazzas. Each module is built for daylight and can be divided or combined, with the option of adding a mezzanine.

panels.title: Privates, Twins & Quads
panels.text: Each building divides into one, two or four separate vertical units. Every unit gets its own entrance and its own common areas, so a business can take a whole building or a quarter of one without sharing a lobby.

panels.title: Beside Gate 01
panels.text: The office zone sits in District 5’s non-residential area with direct access onto the Cairo–Ain Sokhna road, so staff and visitors never drive through the residential streets. Road 90 is eight minutes away.

en.footer_disclaimer: Not the official Marakez website. Prices, plans and renders are indicative and subject to change; official terms are confirmed by Marakez at the point of sale.
